objective: Reuse actual native ARE episode dispatch/recycling/evidence-state/final-selection machinery for matched adaptive method localization, not an isolated prompting surrogate.
canonical_source: implementation/agent-reasoning-engine/benchmarks/contextbench-v1/episode.mjs remains unchanged. Private in-memory module adaptation binds canonical/effective SHA, replaces exactly one repair instruction with localization-only instruction, retains pending native tool exchanges unconditionally in three seams and adds one pre-tool action-budget event. Relative dependencies become exact absolute module URLs.
tools: Both arms: same qualified method_navigation, complete-method read_file and native recover_observed_read. Fixed host case ID cannot be injected by model. Reads preserve exact method bytes and SHA with explicit span scope, not falsely whole physical source lines or whole-file reads. Canonical adapter checks current source bytes before delivery.
treatment: Native index arm uses confirmed observed-source index and existing post-recycle task-state projection. These are observed facts, not inferred correctness or a new semantic hypothesis evaluator. Baseline uses autonomous shared-tool exploration without these added state presentations. Both retain pending tool exchange, same source/runtime universe, caps and native receipt/final-selection checks.
bounds: Default11 model calls,512 output tokens,65536 cumulative generation tokens,10 tool actions INCLUDING recovery and invalid attempts. Index/state tokenizer overhead and all provider calls must be retained. No terminal/incomplete-answer retries. Production provider transport still requires exact8K tokenizer admission before every dispatch.
qualification: Eight synthetic tests through real native episode/recycler, then separately frozen all16/two-arm offline pipeline using real qualified source methods. Scripted public responses do not establish model accuracy, fresh confirmation or provider admission.
claim_ceiling: Private native adapter functionality only; no scored quality, full ContextBench reproduction, production activation or superiority
open_questions: Do actual same-account8K tokenizer/provider calls satisfy equal budgets across all32 adaptive episodes?
Does the existing evidence-state treatment improve native top-one localization over the strong equal-access adaptive baseline?
If desired semantic hypothesis evaluation differs from existing native state projection, what distinct prospective mechanism should be tested next without mislabeling this adapter?
Which disjoint native confirmation population can establish the eventual claim scope?
